basic_profile.bio: I'm a college student majoring in Computer Science at Lone Star College. I recently got into Minecraft and love exploring new ideas in the game. I'm originally from Houston, Texas, and I usually browse Reddit during the evenings after classes or late at night when I can't sleep. I'm single and enjoy watching comedy sketches, especially Key & Peele. I'm not a fan of overly complicated mods in games, but I appreciate innovative ideas for vanilla gameplay.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational knowledge in computer programming from my college courses. Most of my Minecraft knowledge is self-taught through YouTube tutorials and community discussions. I'm still learning about different game mechanics and mods.
